title: You can open the record of the session that produced a finished result, from the result itself
tier_reason: one HQ page file; git reverts it
ask: Every model session is now written down under hq/data/runs/workers/ and shown on the bullpen page (#/chat/bullpen). The queue page's briefing pane (hq/static/queue.js) has an evidence list — 'What came back', 'Files changed', 'Test suites', 'Checker' — and should carry one more entry, 'How it was done', linking to that card's session in the bullpen. GET /api/workers returns every session with its `item` field, so match on the card id and link to #/chat/bullpen with the session named in the address; add whatever the bullpen page needs to open one session directly. Touch hq/static/queue.js and hq/static/workers.js only.
first_action: Read the evidence block in hq/static/queue.js and renderWorkers in hq/static/workers.js; give the bullpen an address for one session first.
source_message: Left open when the bullpen was built on 2026-09-20; the queue page it depends on now exists.

landed.note: The evidence list carries "How it was done", which opens that card's sessions in the bullpen.
